narrative.overview: PiKVM Desktop should feel like the desk of a careful expert: the conversation is open in front of them, the computer they are operating is within sight, and the few controls they may need are exactly where their hand expects them. Chat is the primary surface; computer state and tools are supporting context.
keyCharacteristics: Conversation-first hierarchy with a collapsible computer preview.
Compact native desktop chrome and generous space for task content.
Effects shown through target crops, exact text, and evidence—not coordinates.
Restrained neutral surfaces with colour reserved for action and truth.
Keyboard-complete interaction, visible focus, reduced motion, and 200% scaling.

rules.name: The Scarce Colour Rule
rules.body: High-signal blue occupies no more than ten percent of a normal workspace. Semantic colour never acts alone.

rules.name: The Read-Once Rule
rules.body: User-facing effects use plain language at body or title size. Raw tool names and identifiers never dominate.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: A shadow must explain layering or focus. It may not decorate a resting card.

dos: Do make chat the control surface and keep the current computer visible as supporting context.
Do show effects with target crops, before/after frames, exact text, and independent evidence.
Do keep controls at least 32px high with a visible focus-visible state.
Do use evidence green, caution amber, and destructive red together with words and icons.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion and keep the product usable at 200% scale.
donts: Don't present a verbose developer console as the user-facing tool.
Don't build a NOC dashboard full of panels, telemetry cards, and unexplained coordinates.
Don't use a terminal-themed interface that treats logs as visibility.
Don't ship a generic chatbot that hides tool execution or shows only a spinner.
Don't use a hidden operator whose decisions and screen state cannot be inspected.
Don't recreate production-ready chat, tool-call, dialog, or form primitives.
Don't add decorative motion, gratuitous glass effects, or AI control centre styling.
